text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, I lost.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Scarlet...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Ohhhhh!
Go, Fine Motion!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The eyes of every spectator in the venue
are on
Fine. I can't help but feel a
resounding defeat...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hey, would you run with me a little
more? I don't
like to wallow in these
things.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Grk.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, I couldn't pull it off. It looks like
you'll be
taking the victory and going
home.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'll... I'll definitely come and visit you.
...So race
me again when I do!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Of course! ...Someday.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. It's wonderful. I've finally reached
it—this
wonderful view.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What? You're thanking me for losing?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Shakur! You big silly!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Haaah?! The hell did you just sa—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You came to win and you did your best.
In the
end, you lost.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You were never running for my sake.
And I don't
care for any insinuation that
you were!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...
Pretty lame, huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I knew from the start how this would
play out. I
knew I'd lose and that would
be the end of the
road for me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But where's the fun in that? So I kept
searching
for something that could
distort the result.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Shakur...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And that's when I found you, Fine. You
were
different. At first, all I cared about
was getting
some unique data and
analyzing it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But then, one day... you defied my
predictions. In
that moment, a thought
crossed my mind.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: If anyone can change their fate, it's her.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I thought if I could get you to keep
running—to
defy your destiny—then that
would prove that my
fate could change
as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: So I put my faith in a dumb hypothesis and clung to it... like an idiot.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: And this is where it's got me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Even so... even with this result... This isn't
grounds
for you to give up, is it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Come on now. Even in that split-second
when I
beat you, I could see every one
of your neurons
firing.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
When I spoke to you, I got a glimpse of
that face
of yours that I love so much.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Facing up to your discontent and
running with the
hope of never being
forgotten... I know what it's
like.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure that the more you open up
about your
feelings, like just now... the
more they'll resonate
with the hearts of
others.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I did what I needed to for my sake. What
about
you?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
How about you quit your yapping and
take a
hike?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Thank you, Shakur!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Farewell...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we have a press conference
to
announce Fine Motion's return to
Ireland.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm all right.
...Hey, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm very fortunate, aren't I? I'm a truly,
truly
blessed individual.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I got to run so much, and I made so
many friends.
I heard the glorious sound
of countless cheers.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Right. I'm sure they'll all remember me.
choice_data_list: 君の衝撃を、誰も忘れない
貴方の衝撃を、誰も忘れない
choice_data_list_en: No one will ever forget the impact you made.
No one will ever forget the impact you made.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: And I believe it'll be a dazzling memory.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Fine!
Don't quit! Keep racing!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all so much. However, I must
bring
these wonderful three years to a
close.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
This exquisite ending has been decided
from the
very start.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Every race has a beginning and an end.
But in our
memories, it becomes more
than a simple
contest...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
As long as you none of you forget me,
I'll live on
in your memories.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
So please, allow me to stay... within your
hearts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion's eyes glisten in rare fashion
as she
smiles on at the crowd.
